full_prompt_en: A square painterly city scene shows two dark figures walking along a broad street toward a warm orange sunset. The sky fills the upper third with glowing ocher and pale gold, broken by loose darker cloud strokes. Across the middle, a low block of gray-brown buildings forms the far end of the street; a narrow doorway or lit opening glows near the left side of this façade. Tall dark trees and upright streetlamps line the left edge. One lamp burns yellow against the shadowed trunks, while a nearly black tree mass encloses the upper right corner. The street begins in the lower foreground as a wide textured plane and narrows toward the buildings, its worn surface catching bands of salmon, orange, and dusty violet light. Near the right of center, two figures in dark long coats and brimmed hats walk side by side away from the viewer. Their bodies are almost pure black and have little facial or clothing detail. Small farther figures appear near the distant entrance, their shapes reduced to quick dark marks. The left curb bends inward, guiding the eye from the front corner toward the glowing doorway and sunset sky. Warm light falls low across the road and glances off the wall, while the trees and walkers remain deep silhouettes. Thick, broken brush strokes and a slightly gritty painted surface keep the setting loose rather than photographically exact. The overall composition is nostalgic and quiet, balancing the pair of black figures against a broad sunlit street and dark framing foliage.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式城市街景呈现两名深色人物，沿宽阔街道走向暖橙色落日。天空占据上部三分之一，发着赭黄与浅金色光，被较深的松动云笔迹打断。中间，一排低矮灰棕建筑构成街道尽端；立面左侧附近一道窄门洞或亮口发光。高大深色树木和直立路灯沿左缘排列。一盏路灯在阴影树干前发黄光，右上角则被近黑树冠围住。街道在下方前景展开为宽阔有肌理的平面，向建筑处收窄；磨损表面接住鲑粉、橙与灰紫色光带。中央偏右，两名身穿深色长外套、戴宽檐帽的人并排背向观者走去。身体几乎纯黑，面部或衣物细节很少。更远处入口附近还有小人物，形状简化为迅速的深色笔迹。左侧路缘向内弯，把视线从前方角落引向发亮门洞和落日天空。暖光低低横过路面并擦亮墙壁，树木和行人仍是深色剪影。厚实断续笔触和略带颗粒的绘画表面让环境保持松动，而非摄影般精确。整体构图怀旧而安静，以一对黑色人物对照宽阔受光街道和深色框景枝叶。
style_prompt_en: The painted surface uses broken impasto-like strokes of amber, rust, mauve, gray, and deep charcoal. A broad warm field is framed by tall dark masses and punctuated by small upright silhouettes, establishing clear scale and direction. The brightest area sits low behind the central forms, so backlighting turns their details into simple black shapes. Long receding edges and a narrowing band of light organize depth without precise drawing. Thick color patches describe atmosphere and ground texture at once; edges sharpen only where dark and luminous areas meet. A few tiny warm points echo the main glow and keep the composition visually connected. The overall effect is moody, nostalgic, and quietly cinematic, with luminous color emerging from heavy shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画表面使用琥珀、铁锈、淡紫、灰和深炭色的断续厚涂般笔触。宽阔暖色区域被高大深色团块框住，并以细小直立剪影点缀，建立清楚的尺度与方向。最亮处落在中央形态后方的低位，逆光因此将其细节压成简单黑形。向远处收拢的长边线与变窄光带组织深度，无需精确线描。厚实色斑同时描述空气与地面肌理；边缘只在深色与发亮区域相遇处锐化。少量细暖色亮点呼应主要光晕，使构图相连。整体效果阴郁、怀旧而安静地带电影感，发亮色彩从厚重阴影里浮现。
theme_en: Two dark figures walking toward a warm city sunset
theme_zh: 两名深色人物走向温暖的城市落日
name: James Wilson Morrice
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
